claims.claim: Xbox One with one pad for sell
claims.evidence: No logo, model text, or distinctive Xbox One console shape is visible in either photo; only a generic black console and a controller with ABXY-style colored buttons (consistent with but not proof of Xbox branding) are shown.
Photo 1 shows a hand placing one controller on the console; only one controller is visible in either photo.
No games, game cases, or discs are visible in either photo.
No power adapter is shown in either photo, so the claimed fault cannot be confirmed or contradicted; seller's own admission is noted but not visually corroborated.

risks.risk: True brand/model of the console is unconfirmed (witness could not read it from photos)
risks.proof: Clear photo of the console's top or rear showing the Xbox logo, model number, and serial sticker
risks.if_unproven: price as an unbranded/unverified generic console, not confirmed Xbox One

risks.risk: Power adapter missing or faulty as seller admits an 'adaptor issue'
risks.proof: Photo of the actual power brick/cable, or a short video of the console powering on with it
risks.if_unproven: price as console without working power adapter (non-functional until proven otherwise)

risks.risk: Console may not power on or boot to dashboard at all
risks.proof: Video clip of the console powering on, showing the home screen/dashboard
risks.if_unproven: price as non-functional / for-parts worst case

risks.risk: HDMI/AV cable not shown, may be missing

risks.proof: Photo of console settings/storage screen or rear label showing GB capacity
risks.if_unproven: price at lowest common capacity tier

risks.risk: Condition of ports/connectors (HDMI, USB, power socket) not visible
risks.proof: Close-up photos of rear port panel
risks.if_unproven: price as unverified port condition, assume possible damage

risks.risk: Claimed 6 games including FC not shown; physical media, cases, or digital licenses unverified
risks.proof: Photo of the game discs/cases or a screenshot of the games library on the dashboard
risks.if_unproven: price as console+controller only, games excluded

risks.risk: Controller battery type and condition (rechargeable vs disposable, battery health) unknown
risks.proof: Photo of controller's battery compartment or charging port

proof_requests: Clear photo of console rear/underside showing brand logo, model number, and serial sticker
Photo or video of the power adapter and the console powering on with it
Video clip showing the dashboard/home screen loading successfully
Photo of HDMI cable if included
Photo of storage capacity on settings screen
Close-up photos of all rear ports
Photo of the 6 game discs/cases or screenshot of games library
Photo of controller battery compartment/charging port
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a game console with one controller, so it can be priced, but brand, functionality, included games, and the admitted adapter fault are all unverified and must be priced at worst case until proven.
